C-01.summary: The re-dating scenario (N02) is fixed, including replay, a recurring run and release on reopen. The same result is reachable through supersession under a new key.

C-02.summary: All five decision types, dispositions and finalization refuse with 409 PERIOD_LOCKED; an audited reopen by a granted human is required; decisions are accepted afterwards.

C-03.summary: Identical work by another enqueuer or mandate issuer reuses the artifact and keeps the rejection and the approval; contributors append outside the hash; a newly linked contributor loses review rights.

C-04.summary: Every version supplier and every author and approver of chart, entity and book configuration stays barred; another item's receipt does not bar. One P2 residual for superseded rule versions.

C-05.summary: Marks are kept; unknown and colliding aliases are held; empty aliases refused.

C-06.summary: Kind is mandatory; a service identity is refused for every human authority, including when grants are issued to it.

maintained_harness_judgment.status: accepted as an adaptation, not as sufficient evidence
points: Setup changes (proposed-then-approved profile, explicit grants, structured statements, lock acknowledgement) keep the original assertions for N01 to N07; my independent versions with explicit setup agree.
Every mandate probe uses create_fixture_mandate, which supplies an empty freshness predicate and the occurrence-calendar rule, so the harness never exercises the freshness control (RV-11).
prepare_profile approves through a fixed second actor inside the helper. That is explicit but it means no maintained probe tests a withdrawn mapping, a superseded rule author or an untyped checklist.
N16 and N18 remain NOTE. N18 is not evidence that alias normalisation is visible to an approver (RV-14).

Period contracts stated in the case text; outcome remains no eligible entry.

Used only by the runner and the fixture builder, never by intake. It preserves a wrong declared count or total as a wrong statement. It takes line ids from the intake population, so the 60 cases cannot detect a line-identity defect; probes RT13 and RT13n cover that.
